lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits; the central two rows exhibit a staggered, near-checkerboard arrangement of approximately six visible centroids each.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank displays a sharp vertical gradient (lighter pixels above, darker pixels below), indicating a longitudinal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small circular region of reddish-brown pixel intensity is located in the upper-central flank between the two uppermost rows of spots; a dark, thin, horizontal feature is present mid-flank below the third gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: A light-colored, elongated feature with a tapered posterior is visible at the lower boundary of the frame, adjacent to the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
